content: The American Diabetes Association recommends that every hospital establish a specific protocol aimed at both preventing and treating hypoglycemia. It is essential that all hypoglycemic episodes are thoroughly documented and monitored as part of the hospital's quality improvement processes. Hospitals are advised to routinely evaluate and modify treatment plans to minimize the risk of hypoglycemia. This is particularly important in cases where patients experience recurrent episodes of hypoglycemia or when blood glucose levels fall below 70 mg/dL (3.9 mmol/L).
